'''Latelle Luca''' is a bear trainer in [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Traveling Show]].{{ref/book|5|17}} She is also married to Valan.{{ref/book|9|15}}

==Appearance==
Latelle Luca is a stern-faced woman with dark eyes and short dark hair.

==Activities==
===Before marriage===
When [[Elayne Trakand]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Thomdril Merrilin]] and [[Juilin Sandar]] join Valan's show, he introduces them to Latelle.{{ref/book|5|17}} When the [[Chavana]] brothers flirt with Nynaeve over dinner, Latelle attacks Nynaeve with a stick. This causes Nynaeve to respond in kind and [[Petra Anhill]], the show's strongman, has to carry Latelle back to her wagon.{{ref/book|5|24}} When Valan learns of this, he forces Nynaeve to apologize to Latelle.{{ref/book|5|25}} Later, when [[Cerandin]] and Nynaeve begin fighting, Latelle seems to still hold a grudge as she hands Cerandin a stick.{{ref/book|5|33}} This grudge, however, appears to have mellowed, if not vanish, when Nynaeve and her group depart the show in [[Samara]].{{ref/book|5|48}}

===After marriage===
Despite Valan wishing to marry Nynaeve, he marries Latelle. She seems to be a bad cook,{{ref/book|9|15}} as [[Matrim Cauthon]] did not like the food she cooked for the dinner Matt had with Valan and Latelle .{{ref/book|10|28}}{{ref/book|11|6}} Latelle is one of the few people who know of [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]], [[Selucia]], and [[Egeanin Tamarath]]'s true identities.{{ref/book|10|1}}
